request.text: Seamless steady loop of a futuristic sports coupe engine at medium RPM, tight throaty mechanical combustion growl with subtle electric turbine whine. Constant speed and volume, dry isolated close recording, no acceleration sweep, no gear changes, no voices, no music, no other vehicles.
